changelog: NEW (dev only): Netflix-style multi-profile support. Add up to 5 profiles per Xtream account, each with their own Continue Watching / Last Channel / Favorites / Watch Progress / Themed Match cache. Cross-device sync now keys by profile so Mom's basement TV and Mom's kitchen tablet share state, but Mom's data doesn't bleed into the Kids profile on the upstairs Fire Stick.
NEW (dev only): 36 illustrated avatars baked into the dev APK — 18 diverse human portraits + 18 cartoon animals (~648 KB total). Generated via Gemini Nano Banana with a consistent style brief.
NEW (dev only): Kids' profile toggle. Hides 18+ categories from Live TV / Movies / Series, and the kid can't exit the profile without entering the master Parental Controls PIN (next iteration).
INHERITED v1.44.137: In-app updater UX fixes + ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE fallback for Fire OS.
INHERITED v1.44.136: Continue Watching dispatches by content kind. HushXXX subsystem code removed.
INHERITED v1.44.132: Lite-mode boot refresh, main-looper resilience handler.
